chapter_title_en: The Sword That Shattered the Trap
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 495: Ji Ning Slays 18 Celestial Immortals – The Seamless Gate Panics
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s power reaches terrifying new heights as he slaughters eighteen elite Celestial Immortals from the Seamless Gate in a single assault. A Pure Yang True Immortal arrives too late to stop the massacre.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 495 – The Sword That Shattered the Trap
og_description: Six sword fingers, a shattered formation, and a massacre of titans. Ji Ning's overwhelming strength leaves the Seamless Gate's leadership in shock.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Goes Full Annihilation Mode
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate’s elite ambush is obliterated as Ji Ning unleashes the terrifying power of Sword Force.

lore_anchors.definition: A Celestial Immortal who has achieved a 'Pure Yang' state, possessing vastly superior power and an immortal body that is far more durable than lower-tier Celestial Immortals.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.
A title for a Celestial Immortal who has reached a state of 'complete unification' of their Dao, making them exceptionally powerful among their peers.
A high-tier, one-use talisman that allows for instantaneous teleportation across vast distances, but requires a few moments to activate.

The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is featureless, devoid of Dao resonance, and forces cultivators to rely solely on physical arts and Heartforce for survival.
A treasure of the highest order, possessing a nascent spirit and incredible power. They are typically only usable by Celestial Immortals and above.

A legendary, hidden sword technique from the primordial era; the Tonghe Immortal reveals it for the first time in this battle, fusing six flying swords into one colossal blade to create an attack that shakes heaven and earth.
A powerful Pure Yang True Immortal of the Seamless Gate and the brother-in-law of the Violetgrass Celestial Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning become so powerful without undergoing his Celestial Tribulation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He comprehended the method to utilize Heartforce through Houyi's techniques and mastered Sword Force, which allows him to multiply his base strength by a massive factor, making him the equal of Tonghe-level Celestial Immortals despite not having ascended.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn't the Seamless Gate predict Ji Ning's power?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They assumed the Realm of Annihilation would prevent him from progressing in Dao comprehension. They failed to account for his independent breakthroughs in Heartforce, a power that does not rely on external Dao resonance.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the Pure Yang Divine Bell given to Yu Wei?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is one of the highest-tier treasures in the known world. Ji Ning loans it to his wife as a strategic move, knowing that the Seamless Gate would have intelligence on him. It protects Anchan City and allows them to trap enemies who try to hide in Immortal estates.
